description: This PHP class, NeptunedataClient, provides a client interface to interact with the Amazon NeptuneData service. It declares numerous methods for executing and managing graph database operations such as queries, jobs, endpoints, and statistics. The class primarily serves as a wrapper around AWS SDK functionality, facilitating various Neptune-related API calls.

classes.name: NeptunedataClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon NeptuneData service, extending the base AWS client class.

methods.name: cancelGremlinQueryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously cancels a Gremlin query operation.

methods.name: createMLEndpoint
methods.description: Creates a new machine learning endpoint for Neptune.

methods.name: getEngineStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the Neptune engine.
